title: Hat of Storm Scion's Power

sources.title: Thunderous Acuity
markers: | summary = '''Thunderous Acuity''' is a passive feature that improves the wearer's spell power after dealing thunder damage.

summary: Direct Thunder damage from the wearer gives 2 turns of Arcane Acuity once per attack.

fields.Arcane Acuity: Gain +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC per remaining turn, up to 10. Taking damage removes 2 turns.
fields.Trigger limit: Thunder from Reverberation does not qualify. Singing Sword: Shrieking damage does not qualify outside Honour Mode.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
